stem.text: The functions \( f \) and \( g \) are continuous for all real \( x \), with \( \displaystyle\int_{0}^{5} f(x)\,dx = 8 \), \( \displaystyle\int_{3}^{5} f(x)\,dx = 3 \), \( \displaystyle\int_{0}^{3} g(x)\,dx = -2 \), and \( \displaystyle\int_{3}^{5} g(x)\,dx = 4 \).

parts.prompt: Find \( \displaystyle\int_{0}^{3} f(x)\,dx \). Show the work that leads to your answer.

points.criterion: Shows a setup from the adjacent interval property, such as 8 - 3, and gives 5. A bare 5 does not earn it.

parts.prompt: Find \( \displaystyle\int_{3}^{0} \left(2f(x) - 4g(x)\right) dx \). Show the work that leads to your answer.

worked_solution.text: Reverse the limits, then use the constant multiple and sum properties.

points.criterion: Shows a setup that reverses the limits and applies the constant multiple and sum properties, such as -(2(5) - 4(-2)), and gives -18. A value consistent with the student's own part (a) value earns it when the setup is otherwise correct. A bare value does not earn it.
